data.name: Auto Empire Tycoon
data.detailed_description:
AUTO EMPIRE TYCOON IS COMING! 🚗🏭

Build your automotive empire, develop new technologies, design your cars, manage production, control your dealerships, and compete for the market.

The wait is almost over.

📅 6 NOVEMBER

Start your journey from a small automotive company and build an empire that will stand the test of time.


About the Game

Build Your Automotive Empire from the Ground Up

Auto Empire Tycoon is a focused automotive business simulation spanning the 1950s to the 2000s.

You start with a modest factory, a small engineering team, and a single dealership. Rival companies are already competing for the same market. Your goal is clear: research new technologies, design superior cars, produce them efficiently, keep your dealership stocked, offer competitive prices, and outsell your rivals to become the market leader.

Every car you create and every dollar you earn helps you unlock new technologies and stay ahead of the competition.

Research New Automotive Technologies

Your success depends on smart research decisions.

Invest your profits in new engines, transmissions, suspensions, body styles, comfort features, and efficiency improvements. Each new technology opens the door to more competitive vehicle models.

A well-timed research decision can give you the edge you need to overtake your rivals.

Design Cars the Market Wants

Don’t build the car you like. Build the car the market is ready to buy.

Combine researched technologies to create new models that match customer expectations for quality, price, fuel efficiency, and style.

A smart design can boost your sales and push you ahead of rival brands. An outdated model can give them a chance to catch up.

Manage Efficient Production

Your cars don’t build themselves.

Run your factory with precision:

  • Set up and retool production lines

  • Control manufacturing costs

  • Manage worker efficiency

  • Balance output with demand

Produce too few cars and you lose sales to your rivals.

Produce too many and your money gets stuck in unsold inventory.

A well-run company turns good designs into real profits.

Keep Your Dealership Stocked and Ready to Sell

A great car means nothing if customers can’t buy it.

Manage your dealership:

  • Control inventory levels

  • Set competitive prices and discounts

  • Hire sales staff

  • Match the right models to the right customers

The better you read local demand, the more cars you sell and the faster you leave your rivals behind.

Outsell Rival Brands

You are not alone in the market.

AI-controlled rival companies design their own cars, run their factories, stock their dealerships, and fight you for every customer.

Study their moves every month:

  • Compare sales reports

  • See which categories they dominate

  • Find their weaknesses

If one rival leads in budget cars, strike back with a better alternative.

If your sales fall behind, improve your models, adjust production, and rethink your strategy.

Only the company that adapts fastest wins.

Read the Market and Stay Ahead

Use detailed reports to make sharp decisions:

  • Which vehicle categories are growing

  • How your models perform against your rivals

  • Which technologies to research next

  • Whether your prices and stock levels are helping or hurting sales

The game rewards clear thinking and timely action. Think like a CEO and stay one step ahead of the competition.

Grow Step by Step into the Market Leader

Start small in the 1950s.

Research better technologies.

Design stronger vehicles.

Optimize production.

Keep your dealership stocked.

Adjust prices.

Study the market.

Outsell your rivals.

Your empire grows through hundreds of smart decisions. In Auto Empire Tycoon, you don’t just manage a car company; you outsmart the competition and build the strongest automotive brand in the city.

Planned Features

  • Vehicle model design using researched technologies and components

  • Automotive technology research tree

  • Factory production management and production line retooling

  • Dealership inventory, pricing, and staff management

  • Rival companies with their own strategies

  • Detailed monthly and yearly sales reports

  • Category and company performance comparisons

  • Bank loans and advertising campaigns

  • Brand reputation and fuel consumption systems

  • Parts suppliers and economic events

  • Isometric city view with live traffic and district overlays

  • Minimap, wealth zones, and demand overlays

  • Save system, tutorial, and multiple scenarios

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 / OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3 equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated or modern integrated GPU with DirectX 11 / OpenGL 4.x support
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon GPU or dedicated/integrated GPU with OpenGL 4.x support
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Linux distribution released after 2018 / SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Linux distribution released after 2020 / SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3 equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated or modern integrated GPU with OpenGL 4.x support
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
